bias: 'Repeated failures at the highs, a potential shift in buyer participation, and PPI set to test the bulls' control.' Thursday: both opened on true gap-downs and sellers immediately lost control — neither could even trade below the second 5-minute candle's low; buyers reclaimed Wednesday's lows, defended the pullback (NQ held Wed low / 28200-28233 from above, ES held above Mon high 7600.5) and confirmed the LBAFs with excess at the lows. But for the second straight session substantial selling came off the highs: NQ surrendered 28443-28485 into the close and negated its upside singles; ES failed 'rather spectacularly' in 7670-7680 again and closed well below 7645-7650. His read of the tape: the large buyer who supported the recovery may have exited into Thursday's highs — an interpretation, not a fact, but if so the next downside attempt may meet considerably less resistance. Auction still broadly constructive above Thursday's lows and Tuesday's high; 'rejection from resistance is not the same thing as establishing downside control.' Bulls still have control, sellers may finally have an opportunity — neither is a prediction.
wildcard: PPI premarket: fresh buyers of size could render Thursday's deterioration irrelevant, or sellers could finally find participation. End of an inside week in a broader downtrend — a Friday close near Thursday's high says buyers keep building; a close near Tuesday's low paints a very different picture. He's willing to consider shorts on failed attempts to reclaim resistance (ES 7645-7650) given the suspected buyer exit, but wants sellers to demonstrate control, not just react. Daily: ES 7689-7694, 7663-7664, 7641-7643 (replaces 7633-7636; keep 7633 = Thu IB high), 7600-7603, 7562-7563; NQ 29194-29220, 28590-28602 (new), 27869, 27689, 27110-27123; NQ honorable mentions 28552, 27920-27930; added Thu IB high 28398.5 and Wed IB high 28426.
